tag: 女子盤腿坐在野餐毯上，籃中有保溫瓶與杯子，前方砧板上有圓麵包

level.why: 多個物品與多種位置關係並存，需辨別被動式擺放、籃內與砧板上的細微位置差異。

image_prompt: A realistic photograph of a picnic blanket with a basket and fruit on the grass. Natural lighting, 4:3 landscape orientation, sharp focus, clean and simple composition, in the style of a TOEIC Part 1 photo. Composition: A rich, detailed scene with many distinct objects (people optional) in clear spatial relationships and states (displayed, stacked, placed, arranged, parked), with fine visible details that allow subtle differences between statements. No text, signs, logos or brand names anywhere; no readable screens or papers; no celebrities; at most 4 people, with natural proportions, normal hands and fingers, and simple, clearly visible hand actions.
visible_facts: One woman is sitting cross-legged on a plaid blanket on the grass.
An open wicker basket holds a thermos, two stacked mugs and some grapes and apples.
She is reaching toward an apple in the basket.
A whole loaf of bread and a knife are on a wooden cutting board in front of her.
Two small plates with bread and cheese, some apples and two oranges are on the blanket.
A large tree and green trees are in the background.

pool.t: A loaf of bread has been placed on a wooden cutting board.
pool.zh: 一條圓麵包被放在木製砧板上。
pool.why: 正解：整條麵包與切片麵包放在木砧板上，與畫面相符。

pool.t: There is a thermos inside the open wicker basket.
pool.zh: 打開的藤編籃裡有一個保溫瓶。
pool.why: 正解：藤編野餐籃已打開，籃中有一個銀色保溫瓶，與畫面相符。

pool.t: A woman is sitting on a plaid blanket beside a picnic basket.
pool.zh: 一名女子坐在格紋毯子上，旁邊有一個野餐籃。
pool.why: 正解：女子盤腿坐在格紋野餐毯上，野餐籃就在她旁邊，與畫面相符。

pool.t: Three mugs are stacked next to the thermos.
pool.zh: 三個馬克杯疊放在保溫瓶旁邊。
pool.why: 保溫瓶旁只有兩個杯子（藍色與白色），數量錯誤。

pool.t: A block of cheese is on the cutting board.
pool.why: 起司放在兩個小盤子上，砧板上只有麵包與刀子。

pool.t: Two women are sitting on the blanket together.
pool.zh: 兩名女子一起坐在毯子上。
pool.why: 毯子上只有一名女子，人數錯誤。

pool.t: The woman is slicing bread with a knife.
pool.zh: 這名女子正用刀子切麵包。
pool.why: 刀子放在砧板上，女子的手伸向籃子裡的蘋果，並沒有在切麵包。

pool.t: The woman is pouring tea into a mug.
pool.zh: 這名女子正把茶倒進馬克杯。
pool.why: 保溫瓶放在籃中，女子沒有在倒茶，她的手伸向蘋果。

pool.t: A dog is sleeping next to the picnic basket.
pool.zh: 一隻狗正睡在野餐籃旁。

pool.t: A bicycle is leaning against the large tree.
pool.zh: 一輛腳踏車靠在大樹上。
pool.why: 畫面中大樹旁沒有腳踏車。

pool.t: Two people are playing chess on the blanket.
pool.zh: 兩個人正在毯子上下棋。
pool.why: chess 與 cheese 音近，但毯子上只有一名女子，放的是起司與麵包，沒有人下棋。

pool.t: She is waiting for her friends to join the picnic.
pool.zh: 她正在等朋友來加入野餐。
pool.why: 畫面看不出她在等朋友，這是過度推論。

vocab.col: steel thermos / hot drink in a thermos
a loaf of bread / fresh loaf
block of cheese / slice of cheese
